claude.rationale: This was a whole-company going-private cash merger in which "ClubCorp's entire existing operating business, brand, and a substantial portion of its incumbent senior operating management crossed into the new Apollo-affiliated ownership structure via a single merger vehicle," with the merger explicitly "not structured as a spin-off, carve-out, or asset-only purchase" — the customer-facing clubs (T4) and the operations that run them (T5) moved together within one intact corporate structure, so gap_45 = 0. Interim covenants required conducting the business "in the ordinary course consistent with past practice," and incumbent operating managers (President/COO Burnett, GC Keiser, CFO McClellan) continued and were installed as directors, so processes (T5) transferred alongside the people/organization running them (T6), yielding gap_56 = 0. T1 is coded replace because the pre-merger Board was removed and Parent-designated (Apollo) ownership/control was installed at the effective time.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a whole-company merger where the entire operating business, clubs, and management crossed the ownership boundary together. No structural gaps between product, process, or organization were documented at closing.
